ivqs.prompt: What command is executed to bundle your original React source code into optimized, minified production files inside the dist directory?

options.text: npm start --dev
npx webpack --mode production
git push origin main
node server.js

ivqs.prompt: Near the end of the video, what caused the deployment to initially fail with a missing bundle.js error, and how was it resolved?

options.text: The repository name contained capital letters; it was resolved by renaming the repository to lower-case.

The built HTML was attempting to look for /bundle.js at the root domain level instead of relative to the project sub-directory; it was resolved by setting publicPath: './' in the Webpack configuration.
The site was missing a certificate; it was fixed by purchasing a domain name.
GitHub Pages does not support JavaScript; fixed by rewriting the app in HTML.
